scope: Research only. This artifact governs a validation gate for the 2024 CE Interview PUMD. It does not authorise any DMI figure to be sourced from PUMD, and it does not alter the Milestone-2 classification of any UCC.

estimand.units: US dollars per consumer unit per year
estimand.published_side: The value of the LABSTAT LB01 series, process code M. cx.series carries only process code M for demographics code LB01, so LB01 publishes a mean per consumer unit and nothing else at the series level.
estimand.pumd_side: sum(FINLWT21 * COST * stub_factor) over calendar-2024 MTBI records, divided by sum(FINLWT21 * MO_SCOPE / 12) over FMLI records in the same population.
estimand.note: A mean is never compared with an aggregate. The cx.aspect AG value is a different estimand and is not used in this benchmark.

eligibility: not one of the 58 Milestone-1 exception UCCs
present in CE-HG-Inter-2024.txt with section == EXPEND and survey == I
LABSTAT publishes a mean for all six LB01 populations
roster_selection_rule.stratification: equal-count terciles of the eligible pool by published All-CU mean, descending, ties broken by ascending UCC
roster_selection_rule.node_filter: only DMI nodes with at least one eligible UCC in every tercile, so each retained node spans the full magnitude range
roster_selection_rule.within_cell: the median member by rank within the (node, stratum) cell

derivation_of_the_acceptance_rule.principle: The thresholds are derived from what BLS documents about why PUMD estimates differ from published tables, not from the observed error distribution.

documented_sources_of_divergence.quote_gist: Analysis of the Interview survey alone, and non-disclosure criteria, cause PUMD estimates to diverge from published estimates.
documented_sources_of_divergence.effect_on_this_benchmark: The Interview-only component is largely removed by construction: every roster UCC carries survey code I in the 2024 Interview hierarchical grouping file, so BLS itself publishes it from the Interview. What remains is the non-disclosure component.

documented_sources_of_divergence.quote: Published tables use confidential data, and are not adjusted to comply with non-disclosure requirements. By contrast, PUMD have been adjusted to protect the respondents' privacy.
documented_sources_of_divergence.effect_on_this_benchmark: Topcoding and related alterations perturb individual COST values and shift high-income consumer units across income boundaries. This is the dominant expected error, it is largest in the top quintile, and it is bounded but not zero.
FINCBTXM is an imputation mean. Quintile assignment therefore differs from the confidential assignment for consumer units near a boundary, in both directions.

why_these_magnitudes.per_ucc_abs_pct_error_max: A single-digit-percent tolerance is what a source that reproduces published structure must achieve; 10 percent allows for disclosure perturbation and boundary reassignment without permitting an estimate that is materially wrong.
why_these_magnitudes.median_abs_pct_error_max: The typical comparison should be close, not merely tolerable, so the median is held to half the per-cell tolerance.
why_these_magnitudes.p90_abs_pct_error_max: The tail is allowed to be worse than the per-cell tolerance because the roster deliberately includes small, high-RSE items where a few dollars is a large percentage.
why_these_magnitudes.per_ucc_pass_fraction_min: One comparison in five may exceed the per-cell tolerance before the source is judged unusable.
why_these_magnitudes.mean_signed_pct_error_abs_max: Errors should be dispersion, not bias. A systematic signed error would indicate a wrong annualization or a wrong weight, which is a different failure from noise.
why_these_magnitudes.small_value_absolute_floor: Below ten dollars a year, a percentage against the published base is not informative; those cells are judged on absolute difference instead. This is the alternate diagnostic, not an exemption.

precommitment_disclosure.honest_statement: Not every threshold in this file is blind.
precommitment_disclosure.blind_meaning: No UCC-level percentage error had been computed when these were written. The expenditure comparison had not been run.
precommitment_disclosure.not_blind_meaning: The population and quintile-assignment stages were prototyped before this file was written, so the total consumer-unit agreement and the per-quintile population agreement had already been observed. Those two thresholds are therefore informed rather than blind, and are reported as such rather than presented as predictions.
precommitment_disclosure.consequence: If the expenditure benchmark fails, these thresholds are not to be loosened. A failure is a valid outcome and is reported as one.

exclusion_rationale.why: Milestone 2 classified these four as CONCORDANCE_ONLY_UCC with pumd_membership = VERIFIED and pumd_quantitative_usability = NOT_ESTABLISHED. Letting them influence a tolerance would make the tolerance a function of the very UCCs whose usability is unresolved.
exclusion_rationale.how_enforced: They cannot enter the roster: the eligibility rule requires DIRECT_CONCORDANCE_UCC, and RosterEntry.__post_init__ raises if one appears anyway. run_benchmark raises if the roster intersects the exclusion list. No annual or quintile expenditure estimate is calculated, printed, saved or reported for any of them by this task.
exclusion_rationale.corroboration_found_during_this_task: None of 910104-910107 appears in CE-HG-Inter-2024.txt or CE-HG-Integ-2024.txt, while 910050, 910101, 910102 and 910103 do. The PUMD dictionary documents MTBI PUBFLAG 1 as 'Not published' and 2 as 'Published in Integrated Bulletin'. Both findings corroborate the frozen Milestone-2 result; neither changes it.

population_validation.gate: The population and quintile structure is validated and reported before any expenditure comparison, so that a bad quintile reconstruction cannot be mistaken for a bad annualization.
